title: hyv-apply-rewrite
description: Validate and apply a model response to a prepared rewrite task, then run local gates.
evidence_requirements: Report only the deterministic result the command returns; never invent a model or provider call that did not occur.
stop_conditions: Stop when required input is missing, when the command cannot run without changing existing behavior, or when a claimed capability is unavailable.

tool_free_mode.behavior: Provide the decision, artifact template, and exact unavailable capability; never claim a tool action occurred.
